card.name: Words after not/even that deny an obstacle
card.fires_on: The word right after a negation or concessive cue such as "not", "isn't any", "even", where the sentence says something does not block, prevent or hinder. Often the start of a word like "preclude" or "held back".

modes.label: After "not" before hold/preclude
modes.description: Word or word start after "should not" or "has not" that continues a phrase about not preventing something.
modes.example: The presence of sodium metabisulfite in this product should not<< pre>>clude its use for the treatment of hyp

modes.label: Concessive "even" or comparison
modes.description: Word after "even" or "any" that sets up a downplayed or limited claim.
modes.example: The expected incidence of these events, however, is so low that even<< if>> pramipexole caused these events

card.plain: It marks the spot after a negating phrase where the text is saying something does not stop or hinder another thing.
